description: Start billed asynchronous enrichment of an entity list against exactly one of schema_id or target_schema. Returns job_id and total. No fixed entity-count cap; live prompt quotas and credits can stop remaining work. Each entity follows the enrichment/fusion pipeline; every model must succeed for its automatic fusion and database admission. A confident classification mismatch skips that entity without enrichment, never pauses the batch. Poll get_job_status, then list_records(job_id=...). Attachments apply to every entity. Unlike enrich_entity, this tool exposes neither database_sync=false nor web-search activation. Input contracts, partial results and recovery: enricher://docs/batch-enrichment.

arbitration_model.description: Optional LLM for auto-fusion conflict resolution (None = rule-based).
arbitration_model.title: Arbitration Model

attachment_ids.description: Attachment UUIDs applied as source material to every entity.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

classification_model.description: Optional classifier key. Confident mismatches skip that entity; softer verdicts become prompt context. Batch classification never pauses.
classification_model.title: Classification Model

entities.description: Entities to enrich (each a free-form dict naming the entity — the schema's identifying fields ideally, but any field names work).
entities.title: Entities

models.description: Model composite keys (call list_models to discover them). Optional: omit (or pass ['auto']) to let the server pick the org's default model — pinned per-task default if set, else the best blended benchmark score.
models.title: Models

schema_id.description: UUID of a saved schema. Mutually exclusive with target_schema.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

target_schema.description: Inline schema document in the supported Entity Enricher dialect. Prefer schema_id to link records. See enricher://docs/schema-reference.
target_schema.title: Target Schema

name: start_batch_enrichment
title: Start batch enrichment
